title: Which RDS protection?
claim: Each failure has its own RDS answer: a standby for a zone, a replica for reads or a Region, a restore for a mistake.
alt: A ladder of four questions and a last answer: zone failure, Multi-AZ; too many reads, read replica; Region failure, cross-Region read replica; bad change, point-in-time restore; otherwise, manual snapshots for years.

rungs.q: Must writes survive a zone failure?
Too many reads on the primary?
Must it survive a Region failure?
Must you undo a bad change?
